Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Play: Run the simulation. Off freezes agents and trails in place.
Reset: Pulse: restart the simulation and re-seed all agents using Initpattern and Seed.
Seed: Random seed for agent placement. Change it and press Reset for a different start.
Initpattern: Starting layout of agents. random: scattered everywhere. disc: filled circle heading inward. ring: circle outline heading outward.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Attraction: Strength of the pull toward the input image's brightness field. 0 = free-running; negative repels agents from bright areas.
Invert: Follow dark areas of the input instead of bright ones.
Fieldpower: Contrast of the attractor field: luminance is raised to this power. Above 1 favours only the brightest areas; below 1 flattens.
Fieldblur: Blur in pixels applied to the attractor field. Larger values let agents notice features from farther away.
Agents: Number of active agents (1,000 to 262,144). More agents give denser trails but cost more.
Sensorangle: Angle in degrees between the front sensor and the left/right sensors. Wide = thick webs, narrow = straight lines.
Sensordist: Distance in pixels at which agents sense the trail. Short with more Diffuse gives fine veins.
Turnspeed: How far in degrees an agent turns per step toward the strongest sensor.
Stepsize: Distance in pixels an agent moves each frame.
Deposit: Amount of trail each agent adds per frame. Higher gives brighter, thicker trails.
Decay: Fraction of trail kept each frame (0.8-1). Closer to 1 = long-lasting trails; lower fades quickly.
Diffuse: Amount (0-1) of 3x3 blur mixed into the trail each frame. Higher softens and spreads trails.
Colormode: Trail colour source. ramp: Color1 to Color2 to Color3 by trail strength. tint: single Tint colour. image: colours taken from the input.
Compose: How trails combine with the input. over: replace it where trails are strong. add: add light. screen: soft brighten.
Inputlevel: Brightness of the input image shown underneath the trails. 0 = trails on black.
Gain: Trail brightness multiplier before colouring. Higher saturates weak trails.
Tint: Trail colour used when Trail Colour is tint.
Color1: Ramp colour for the weakest trails (used when Trail Colour is ramp).
Color2: Ramp colour for mid-strength trails (used when Trail Colour is ramp).
Color3: Ramp colour for the strongest trails (used when Trail Colour is ramp).
